query:
SELECT (
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l
                    WHERE l.locktype = 'advisory'
                      AND l.granted
                      AND l.classid = ($1::int)::oid
                      AND l.objid = (hashtext($2))::oid
                      AND l.objsubid = 2
                )
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM services s
                    WHERE s.instance_id = $2
                      AND s.heartbeat_at
                          >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $3::double precision)
                )
            ) AS "alive!"
